question: When is production expected to begin in J M Smucker's (NYSE: SJ) new distribution center in McCalla, Alabama?
model_answer:
**Short answer: 2025 (calendar year 2025) — though in practice the plant came online ahead of that schedule, in late 2024.**

Details:

- When The J.M. Smucker Co. (NYSE: **SJM** — the ticker is SJM, not SJ) announced the project on Nov. 18, 2021, it said the $1.1 billion manufacturing facility and distribution center in McCalla, Alabama (JeffMet Industrial Complex, Jefferson County) would begin construction no later than January 2022, **"with production commencing in calendar year 2025."**
- The company's FY2024 Form 10-K (filed June 2024) repeated this: construction began in 2022, **"with production expected to begin in 2025."** Its FY2024 annual report similarly said the facility was "on track to begin production in our fiscal year 2025" (fiscal 2025 = May 2024–April 2025).
- In the interim the timeline was pulled forward: in August 2023 local officials said the target was **May 2024**, and by its fiscal Q2 2025 results (quarter ended Oct. 31, 2024) Smucker said it had **"successfully started production"** at McCalla. The 900,000-sq-ft facility was formally opened with a ribbon-cutting on **Nov. 7, 2024**, with the first production line already running and additional lines being phased in.

So the stated expectation in the company's filings was **production beginning in 2025**, but actual production began earlier, in the fall of 2024, with the phase-two expansion being accelerated toward the end of fiscal 2027.
judge_reason: The answer gives the expected production start as 2025, matching the rubric.
